create_esm_wrapper: create an ESM wrapper to generate protein language model embeddings from amino acid residue indices
create_prostt5_wrapper: create a ProstT5 wrapper to generate protein language model embeddings using T5 encoder
run_remove_plms_decorator: run the remove_plms decorator to temporarily remove and restore PLMs during model inference
build_plm_registry: build a PLM registry mapping embedding type names to their factory functions
test_plm_embeddings: test PLM embedding generation for batches of protein sequences using ESM or ProstT5 wrappers
